claim: API Gateway does not enforce a quota on concurrent WebSocket connections. The number is set by the rate of new connections per second and the maximum connection duration of two hours; with the default of 500 new connections per second, API Gateway can serve up to 3,600,000 concurrent connections.
question: Does API Gateway limit concurrent WebSocket connections, and how many can it serve at the default connection rate?

values.spoken: three point six million concurrent connections

qualifiers.scope: per account, per Region, across all WebSocket APIs
qualifiers.condition: Example assumes clients connect at the maximum rate of 500 new connections per second over two hours.

evidence.quote: \* API Gateway doesn't enforce a quota on concurrent connections. The maximum number of concurrent connections is determined by the rate of new connections per second and maximum connection duration of two hours. For example, with the default quota of 500 new connections per second, if clients connect at the maximum rate over two hours, API Gateway can serve up to 3,600,000 concurrent connections.
